4|LIBJQ_INCS = src/builtin.h src/bytecode.h src/compile.h                 \
5|        src/exec_stack.h src/jq_parser.h src/jv_alloc.h src/jv_dtoa.h   \

7|        src/linker.h src/locfile.h src/opcode_list.h src/parser.y       \

20|### C build options
21|
22|AM_CFLAGS = -Wextra -Wall -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-unused-function \
23|            -Woverlength-strings
24|
25|if WIN32
26|AM_CFLAGS += -municode
27|endif
28|
29|ACLOCAL_AMFLAGS = -I config/m4
30|
31|### Generating the lexer and parser
32|
33|# While there is some autoconf macro support for lex/flex, it doesn't support
34|# header file creation so we'll use good old make
35|if MAINTAINER_MODE
36|BUILT_SOURCES = src/lexer.h src/lexer.c src/parser.h src/parser.c \
37|                src/builtin.inc
38|src/lexer.c: src/lexer.l
39|	$(AM_V_LEX) flex -o src/lexer.c --header-file=src/lexer.h $<
40|src/lexer.h: src/lexer.c
41|else
42|BUILT_SOURCES = src/builtin.inc
43|.y.c:
44|	$(AM_V_YACC) echo "NOT building parser.c!"
45|.l.c:
46|	$(AM_V_LEX) echo "NOT building lexer.c!"
47|endif
48|
49|# Tell YACC (Bison) autoconf macros that you want a header file created.
50|# If the --warnings=all fails, you probably have an old version of Bison
51|# macOS ships an old Bison, so update with Homebrew or MacPorts.
52|AM_YFLAGS = --warnings=all -Wno-yacc -d
53|
54|### libjq
55|
56|lib_LTLIBRARIES = libjq.la
57|libjq_la_SOURCES = ${LIBJQ_SRC}
58|libjq_la_LIBADD = -lm
59|libjq_la_LDFLAGS = $(onig_LDFLAGS) -export-symbols-regex '^j[qv]_' -version-info 1:4:0
60|
61|if WIN32
62|libjq_la_LIBADD += -lshlwapi
63|libjq_la_LDFLAGS += -no-undefined
64|endif
65|
66|include_HEADERS = src/jv.h src/jq.h
67|
68|if ENABLE_UBSAN
69|AM_CFLAGS += -fsanitize=undefined
70|endif
71|
72|AM_CPPFLAGS = -I$(srcdir)/src -I$(srcdir)/vendor
73|
74|### Running tests under Valgrind
75|
76|if ENABLE_ASAN
77|AM_CFLAGS += -fsanitize=address
78|NO_VALGRIND = 1
79|else
80|if ENABLE_VALGRIND
81|NO_VALGRIND =
82|else
83|NO_VALGRIND = 1
84|endif
85|endif
86|
87|### Code coverage with gcov
88|
89|if ENABLE_GCOV
90|AM_CFLAGS += --coverage --no-inline
91|endif
92|
93|### Error injection for testing
94|
95|if ENABLE_ERROR_INJECTION
96|lib_LTLIBRARIES += libinject_errors.la
97|libinject_errors_la_SOURCES = src/inject_errors.c
98|libinject_errors_la_LIBADD = -ldl
99|libinject_errors_la_LDFLAGS = -module
100|endif
101|
102|### Building the jq binary
103|
104|src/builtin.inc: $(srcdir)/src/builtin.jq
105|	mkdir -p src
106|	$(AM_V_GEN) od -v -A n -t o1 -- $< | \
107|	sed -e 's/$$/ /' \
108|	    -e 's/\([0123456789]\) /\1, /g' \
109|	    -e 's/ $$//' \
110|	    -e 's/ 0/  0/g' \
111|	    -e 's/ \([123456789]\)/ 0\1/g' > $@
112|src/builtin.o: src/builtin.inc
113|
114|CLEANFILES = src/builtin.inc
115|
116|bin_PROGRAMS = jq
117|jq_SOURCES = src/main.c
118|jq_LDADD = libjq.la -lm
119|
120|if ENABLE_ALL_STATIC
121|jq_LDFLAGS = -all-static
122|endif
123|
124|### Tests (make check)
125|
126|TESTS = tests/mantest tests/jqtest tests/shtest tests/utf8test tests/base64test tests/uritest
127|if !WIN32
128|TESTS += tests/optionaltest
129|endif
130|AM_TESTS_ENVIRONMENT = JQ=$(abs_builddir)/jq NO_VALGRIND=$(NO_VALGRIND)
131|
132|# This is a magic make variable that causes it to treat tests/man.test as a
133|# DATA-type dependency for the check target. As a result, it will attempt to
134|# run any defined targets for tests/man.test as a dependency for check. This
135|# allows us to ensure that the tests are up-to-date if the manual has been updated
136|check_DATA = tests/man.test
137|
138|### Building the man tests
139|
140|# We use the examples in the manual as additional tests, to ensure they always work.
141|# As a result, we need to rebuild the tests if the manual has been updated.
142|# Making changes to the manpage without having the python deps means your
143|# tests won't run. If you aren't making changes to the examples, you probably
144|# don't care. But if you are, then you need to run the tests anyway.
145|tests/man.test tests/manonig.test: $(srcdir)/docs/content/manual/dev/manual.yml
146|if ENABLE_DOCS
147|	$(AM_V_GEN) ( cd ${abs_srcdir}/docs && \
148|	  $(PIPENV) run python validate_manual_schema.py content/manual/dev/manual.yml && \
149|	  $(PIPENV) run python build_mantests.py )
150|else
151|	@echo Changes to the manual.yml require docs to be enabled to update the manual test.
152|	@echo As a result, the manual test is out of date.
153|endif
154|
155|### Building the manpage
156|
157|# We build the docs from the manpage yml. If no changes have been made to the
158|# manpage, then we'll end up using the cached version. Otherwise, we need to
159|# rebuild it.
160|man_MANS = jq.1
161|jq.1.prebuilt: $(srcdir)/docs/content/manual/dev/manual.yml
162|if ENABLE_DOCS
163|	$(AM_V_GEN) ( cd ${abs_srcdir}/docs && \
164|	  $(PIPENV) run python validate_manual_schema.py content/manual/dev/manual.yml && \
165|	  $(PIPENV) run python build_manpage.py ) > $@
166|else
167|	@echo Changes to the manual.yml require docs to be enabled to update the manpage.
168|	@echo As a result, the manpage is out of date.
169|endif
170|
171|jq.1: jq.1.prebuilt
172|	$(AM_V_GEN) cp $(srcdir)/jq.1.prebuilt $@
173|
174|CLEANFILES += jq.1
175|
176|### Build oniguruma
177|
178|if BUILD_ONIGURUMA
179|libjq_la_LIBADD += vendor/oniguruma/src/.libs/libonig.la
180|SUBDIRS = vendor/oniguruma
181|endif
182|
183|AM_CFLAGS += $(onig_CFLAGS)
184|
185|if WITH_ONIGURUMA
186|TESTS += tests/onigtest tests/manonigtest
187|endif
188|
189|### Packaging
190|
191|install-binaries: $(BUILT_SOURCES)
192|	$(MAKE) $(AM_MAKEFLAGS) install-exec
193|
194|DOC_FILES = docs/content docs/public docs/templates                     \
195|        docs/Pipfile docs/Pipfile.lock docs/build_manpage.py            \
196|        docs/build_mantests.py docs/build_website.py docs/README.md     \
197|        docs/validate_manual_schema.py docs/manual_schema.yml
198|
199|EXTRA_DIST = $(DOC_FILES) $(man_MANS) $(TESTS) $(TEST_LOG_COMPILER)     \
200|        jq.1.prebuilt jq.spec src/lexer.c src/lexer.h src/parser.c      \
201|        src/parser.h src/builtin.jq scripts/version libjq.pc            \
202|        tests/modules/a.jq tests/modules/b/b.jq tests/modules/c/c.jq    \
203|        tests/modules/c/d.jq tests/modules/data.json                    \
204|        tests/modules/home1/.jq tests/modules/home2/.jq/g.jq            \
205|        tests/modules/lib/jq/e/e.jq tests/modules/lib/jq/f.jq           \
206|        tests/modules/shadow1.jq tests/modules/shadow2.jq               \
207|        tests/modules/syntaxerror/syntaxerror.jq                        \
208|        tests/modules/test_bind_order.jq                                \
209|        tests/modules/test_bind_order0.jq                               \
210|        tests/modules/test_bind_order1.jq                               \
211|        tests/modules/test_bind_order2.jq                               \
212|        tests/onig.supp tests/local.supp                                \
213|        tests/setup tests/torture/input0.json                           \
214|        tests/optional.test tests/man.test tests/manonig.test           \
215|        tests/jq.test tests/onig.test tests/base64.test tests/uri.test  \
216|        tests/utf8-truncate.jq tests/jq-f-test.sh                       \
217|        tests/no-main-program.jq tests/yes-main-program.jq
218|
219|AM_DISTCHECK_CONFIGURE_FLAGS=--with-oniguruma=builtin
220|
221|# README.md is expected in GitHub projects, good stuff in it, so we'll
222|# distribute it and install it with the package in the doc directory.
223|dist_doc_DATA = README.md NEWS.md COPYING AUTHORS
224|
225|pkgconfigdir = $(libdir)/pkgconfig
226|pkgconfig_DATA = libjq.pc
227|
228|RELEASE ?= 1
229|rpm: dist jq.spec
230|	@echo "Packaging jq as an RPM ..."
231|	mkdir -p rpm/SOURCES rpm/BUILD rpm/BUILDROOT rpm/RPMS rpm/SPECS
232|	cp jq-$(VERSION).tar.gz rpm/SOURCES/
233|	rpmbuild -tb --define "_topdir ${PWD}/rpm" --define "_prefix /usr" --define "myver $(VERSION)" --define "myrel ${RELEASE}" rpm/SOURCES/jq-$(VERSION).tar.gz
234|	find rpm/RPMS/ -name "*.rpm" -exec mv {} ./ \;
235|	rm -rf rpm
